body_text:
An element $a$ of a magma has left cancellation if $ax=ay$
implies $x=y$, and right cancellation if $xa=ya$ implies $x=y$.
A cancellation law is not a consequence of associativity or the
existence of an identity. Every group has both laws because one
may multiply by $a^{-1}$, but a general monoid need not.
